inputs.text:
You have how input [image1] as main editing image, and [image2] as reference image (served as latent conditioning). 

Change the background of [image1] by Integrating the subjects from [image1] into the background of [image2] seamlessly. 

result image must be ultra quality, 4K, photo realistic, real lighting effect. 

You must maintain consistency between foreground subjects and replaced background, of the result image, 
refer to [image1] for consistent picture composition so that you could adapt the edited background to fit it as much as possible; 
and refer to [image2] for environmental lighting so that you could adapt the lighting and shadow for foreground subjects according to it.
